meta.name: SoC Memory
meta.description: A memory of a SoC (Logisim-evolution's SoC Memory): it answers the transactions of its bus in its address range; unwritten words read as random values

bus.label: Bus
bus.title: The SoC bus this memory answers on (Logisim-evolution's Connected bus)

startAddress.label: Start address (hex)
startAddress.title: First byte address of the memory; rounded down to a word boundary

memSize.label: Size
memSize.title: Size of the memory in bytes (Logisim-evolution's Memory size: 2^10 to 2^26 bytes)

status.label: Status
status.title: The address range the memory answers and how much has been written

status.notConnected: Not connected to a bus: choose one in the Bus attribute

circ.idTooLong: The bus id in the file is longer than {{max}} characters: the memory is not connected to a bus
circ.badStartAddress: "{{value}}" is not a 32-bit start address: 0x0 is used
circ.badMemSize: "{{value}}" is not a memory size ({{min}} to {{max}}, the size being 2^n bytes): {{used}} is used
circ.contents: The memory contents ({{words}} written word(s)) are not saved in the file, as in Logisim-evolution: after it is opened, unwritten words read as random values
